notes.subject: oli karamapim ol i go kalabus
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i no inap tok namba tasol; ves bilong bipo (52:28) i gat mak bilong kalabus, olsem na mi putim liklik stori bilong tingting

notes.subject: ol manmeri
notes.rationale: נפש i makim wanpela man o meri i gat win bilong lapun; Tok Pisin i no gat wok hungre bung wantaim 'manmeri'

notes.subject: 832 manmeri
notes.rationale: Namba bilong ol manmeri we oli karamapim i go kalabus — et handet na teti-na-tu

translation: Long et-na-tenpela yia bilong Nevukadretsar, ol manmeri bilong Yerusalayim — et handet, teti na tupela — oli karamapim ol i go kalabus.
